name: Project Review
description: Project status review template covering milestones, risks, decisions, and action items.

sections.title: Status Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a one-paragraph overview of the current project status, overall health, and key takeaways.

sections.title: Milestones & Progress
sections.instruction: List milestones with their current status (on track, at risk, completed) and relevant progress notes.

sections.title: Risks & Blockers
sections.instruction: List current risks, blockers, and dependencies that may impact the project timeline or deliverables.

sections.title: Decisions Made
sections.instruction: List all decisions made during the review meeting, including the rationale behind each.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List all assigned tasks with their owners and due date. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp in the table.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Task | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
